sceneLight-name.label: Name
sceneLight-name.tip: Light Name (note: this is a label for user reference only)

point.name: Point
point.tip: Light that spreads around a point and has attenuation

sceneLight-blend.label: Blend
sceneLight-blend.tip: Choose a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

sceneLight-intensity-box.label: Intensity
sceneLight-intensity-box.tip: Greater Intensity = smaller & brighter internal attenuation of Light

sceneLight-mask.label: Mask
sceneLight-mask.tip: Light cast through a mask image; if not set, defaults to a rectangle

sceneLight-anchorX-box.label: Anchor X
sceneLight-anchorX-box.tip: Horizontal position of rectangular area connection point between Light and Scene

sceneLight-anchorY-box.label: Anchor Y
sceneLight-anchorY-box.tip: Vertical position of rectangular area connection point between Light and Scene

sceneLight-angle-box.label: Angle
sceneLight-angle-box.tip: Rotation angle of the rectangular area

sceneLight-red-box.label: Red
sceneLight-red-box.tip:
Point Light Mode: Red component in the center of light source
Area Light Mode: Input Color (red) * Mask Color (red) / 255 * Red / 255 = Output Color (red)

sceneLight-green-box.label: Green
sceneLight-green-box.tip:
Point Light Mode: Green component in the center of light source
Area Light Mode: Input Color (green) * Mask Color (green) / 255 * Green / 255 = Output Color (green)

sceneLight-blue-box.label: Blue
sceneLight-blue-box.tip:
Point Light Mode: Blue component in the center of light source
Area Light Mode: Input Color (blue) * Mask Color (blue) / 255 * Blue / 255 = Output Color (blue)

sceneLight-direct-box.label: Direct Light Ratio
sceneLight-direct-box.tip: Adjusts how much direct light affects the final rendered color

sceneLight-conditions.label: Conditions
sceneLight-conditions.tip: Set a list of conditions for Light to be created; if they aren't met, the Light isn't created

sceneLight-events.label: Events
sceneLight-events.tip:
$Light Events
Visit"Event Triggered Light"to set the Light
$Options
Autorun: Event triggers as soon as the Light appears (including after reading save data)
Custom: triggered using the 'Call Event' command

sceneLight-scripts.label: Scripts
sceneLight-scripts.tip: Add Script files to extend Light functions
